name: zaystatic-monorepo
description: zaystatic: a Git-based content panel. The npm package lives in packages/zaystatic, the documentation and promo site in docs/.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter zaystatic typecheck && pnpm --filter zaystatic-docs typecheck
scripts.build:docs: pnpm --filter zaystatic build && pnpm --filter zaystatic-docs build
